question: Which location is said to grant accomplishment of the sun's mantra?
premises: The bank of the Yamunā in Kāśī is specified.
Accomplishment of the sun's mantra is attributed to it.
inference: The bank of the Yamunā in Kāśī grants accomplishment of the mantra of the sun.
plain_english: The bank of the Yamunā in Kāśī grants accomplishment of the mantra of the sun.
